description: Resolve spec notation like `[[Prototype]]` (internal slot), `%Object.prototype%` (well-known intrinsic), or `~number~` (sigil enum) to the clauses that mention or define it. Hits ranked by occurrence count + section-prefix bumps for the canonical definition location. `spec` selects '262' or '402'.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

limit.description: Max candidate clauses returned, ranked by relevance score.

notation.description: Spec notation like `[[Prototype]]` (internal slot), `%Object.prototype%` (well-known intrinsic), or `~number~` (sigil enum).

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: spec.symbol_resolve
title: Resolve spec symbol
